title: Faith, Hope and Love Bible Crossword Puzzle — Free on iOS
heading: The Faith, Hope and Love Bible Crossword
description: Solve a 1 Corinthians 13 Bible crossword: charity suffereth long, the sounding brass, the glass darkly. KJV clues, free on iPhone and iPad.
prose: The chapter everyone hears at weddings, in the wording most of them do not expect: the King James Version calls it charity, not love, all the way through. Faith, Hope, and Love takes 1 Corinthians 13 clause by clause — sounding brass and a tinkling cymbal, the tongues of men and of angels, the glass darkly, and the three that abide.

The KJV vocabulary is the whole character of this grid, and it is worth knowing before you start: charity suffereth long, vaunteth not itself, and is not puffed up. The closing verse names the greatest of the three.

clues.text: The greatest of the three that abide, in KJV wording
Without it, a man is as sounding brass or a tinkling one
How many abide: faith, hope, charity

verseText: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
